titles.native: スティッチ!～いたずらエイリアンの大冒険～

description:
Continuing from the first season, Stitch continues to live his live on Izayoi with Yuuna and furthers his quest to get 43 good deeds for the Chitama Spiritual Stone. However, he may learn that family is more important than being the ruler of the universe. Meanwhile, Dr. Hämsterviel, having escaped from prison with Gantu and Reuben after his defeat at the end of the last season, continues to go after Stitch to try to take the "ultimate power" for himself, even sending some of Stitch's "cousins" to attack him.

(Source: Anime News Network)
